1. लक्ष्मीबाई राष्ट्रीय शारीरिक शिक्षण संस्थान ग्वालियर में स्थित है।
The Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education is located in Gwalior.

2. लौंग, पौधे की पुष्प कली से प्राप्त होती है।
Clove is obtained from the flower bud of the plant.

3. भारत में राज्यसभा के पहले सभापति डॉ. एस. राधाकृष्णन थे।
The first Chairman of the Rajya Sabha in India was Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.

4. नंद वंश के शासक महापद्यनंद ने ‘एकराट’, ‘सर्वक्षत्रान्तक’ और ‘द्वितीय परशुराम’ की उपाधि धारण की थी।
Mahapadma Nanda of the Nanda dynasty held the titles ‘Ekarat’, ‘Sarvakshatrantaka’, and ‘Second Parashurama’.

5. विजयनगर में दासों के क्रय-विक्रय को बेसवग कहा जाता था।
The buying and selling of slaves in Vijayanagara was called Besavaga.

6. राष्ट्रीय चिकित्सा विज्ञान अकादमी नई दिल्ली में स्थित है।

Latur, devastated by the 1993 earthquake, is in Maharashtra.

📢 SBI Clerk Cut-Off Prediction

No one can accurately predict the SBI Clerk cut-off—not even by simply looking at previous years’ cut-offs.

This year, several factors can change the scenario:
🔹 Some states have no vacancies.
🔹 Many candidates may apply from other states.
🔹 Competition and exam level can significantly affect the cut-off.

🎯 For General-category candidates, 85+ can be a safer target.
If the exam level is high, 80+ may also remain competitive.

Also, don’t depend only on SBI Clerk. If your state has no vacancies, explore other banking exams as well.

⭐ RRB Bank jobs are also a great career option:
• Better work-life balance
• Home-state/home-region posting opportunities

I know many candidates who are already selected in SBI Clerk but are still preparing for RRB exams.

Some candidates even work as SBI PO for 2 years and then aim for RRB Scale II for better work-life balance.

So, don’t get stressed about cut-off predictions or the absence of vacancies in your state.

🎯 Focus on your preparation, maximize your score, and keep your options open.

💯 Keep doing your best. Success will follow!
